SELECT * FROM "accountings" ORDER BY created_at DESC;

File: plugins/webkul/accounts/config/filament-shield.php | Tables: payment_terms

⚡ Create Accounts Payment_Terms
Accounts • createAccountsPayment_Terms

Purpose: Insert new payment_terms record linked to Accounts
File: plugins/webkul/accounts/config/filament-shield.php | Tables: payment_terms

Consuming Endpoints: POST /admin/api/v1/accounts/payment-terms  
INSERT INTO "payment_terms" (accounts_id, created_at) VALUES ($1, NOW()) RETURNING *;
⚡ Find Accounts by ID
Accounts • getAccountsById

Purpose: Fetch single Accounts record by unique ID
File: plugins/webkul/accounts/config/filament-shield.php | Tables: payment_terms

Consuming Endpoints: GET /admin/api/v1/accounts/payment-terms/{id}  
SELECT * FROM "accountss" WHERE id = $1 LIMIT 1;

Accounts • updateAccountsPayment_Terms

Purpose: Update payment_terms attribute on Accounts
File: plugins/webkul/accounts/config/filament-shield.php | Tables: payment_terms

Consuming Endpoints: PUT /admin/api/v1/accounts/payment-terms/{id}  
UPDATE "accountss" SET payment_terms = $1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $2 RETURNING *;

Purpose: Delete record from accountss by ID

🔁 Request Pipeline

Step-by-step lifecycle of an inbound HTTP request through the application stack. Click any step to see implementation detail.

1
HTTP request received by Nginx / Swoole / FrankenPHP / Sail
▼
Web server routes all requests to public/index.php bootstrap file.
2
Laravel Kernel bootstraps application providers & middleware stack
⚙️ Core Middleware ▼
Registers service providers, loads .env config, and initializes HTTP Kernel.
3
Route matched by Laravel Router (Web / API / Filament Panel)
▼
Route pattern matched against URL parameters. Controller or Livewire component resolved.
4
Sanctum / Session auth middleware verifies identity
🔐 Security Middleware ▼
Auth guard checks Bearer token (API) or session cookie (Admin/Customer Panel). 401 on failure.
5
Filament Shield / Policy Gate checks user authorization
🔐 Security Middleware ▼
@can or Spatie permission checked against user roles. 403 Forbidden on failure.
6
FormRequest / Livewire validation rules executed
🔧 Core Services ▼
Incoming payload validated against rules. Fails with 422 Unprocessable Content if invalid.
7
Controller / Livewire action executes business logic
🔧 Core Services ▼
Service logic invoked. Model events and database transactions triggered.
8
Eloquent ORM / Spatie QueryBuilder executes database queries
🔧 Core Services ▼
SQL queries generated with eager loading. Query results mapped to Model instances.
9
Response formatted — Blade/Livewire DOM update or JSON Resource returned
▼
API Resource serializes model to JSON (200 OK) or Livewire updates reactive DOM diff.
⚠ Exception / Error Flow
click to expand

When an exception is thrown at any layer, the following error handling chain is invoked instead of the normal response path.

1
Unhandled Exception thrown in Controller, Service, or Policy
2
Laravel Exception Handler (app/Exceptions/Handler.php) intercepts
3
Exception mapped to HTTP status code (400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found, 422 Validation Error, 500 Internal Error)
4
Formatted JSON response or Filament error notification displayed to user
🔒 Scope & Isolation

Multi-tenant / User scope enforced via Filament panel guards, customer ownership relations, and global Eloquent query scopes.
